user.title: Repository
user.description: The Git repository holding your configuration, the branch to follow, and the folder under /config to keep it in (your configuration.yaml includes from there). Each deploy makes the folder match the branch exactly: edits made to its files in Home Assistant are discarded.

data_description.url: SSH (git@github.com:you/home.git) for a private repository, or HTTPS for a public one
data_description.folder: Under /config; the repository's name when empty

deploy_key.title: Add the deploy key

webhook.title: Deploy on every push
webhook.description:
Add a webhook to the repository so each push deploys at once (GitHub: Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook; content type application/json; just the push event).

Payload URL: `{url}`

Secret: `{secret}`

GitLab: the same URL, with the secret as its token. The secret is shown only now.

error.bad_folder: Pick a folder under /config, not one of Home Assistant's own (custom_components, www, .storage…)
error.folder_in_use: That folder already has other files in it

abort.already_configured: That folder is already kept by GitOps

data_description.check_config: Home Assistant's own check; a configuration that fails it is rolled back and nothing reloads
data_description.poll_minutes: 0 = only on the webhook, the button or the action

options.none: Nothing (an automation on gitops_deployed does it)

deploy.name: Deploy
deploy.description: Pulls the branch and deploys it now (every repository when none is given).
